McBurnie coughs up blood during Hull draw - gossip
- Published
Scotland striker Oli McBurnie coughs up blood during Hull City's draw with Brentford as Heart of Midlothian fear further injury woe.
Hull City head coach Sergej Jakirovic revealed that Scotland striker Oli McBurnie was coughing up blood at half-time of Sunday's 1-1 draw with Brentford. (Hull Daily Mail, external)
Celtic have no plans to lose Cameron Carter-Vickers and will reject any interest in the 28-year-old United States centre-back in January. (Football Insider, external)
Hearts are preparing for more injury woe this week as they await scans on defenders Harry Milne and Christian Borchgrevink while they may have to wait another month for midfielder Oisin McEntee's return. (Edinburgh Evening News, external)
St Johnstone midfielder Sam Stanton's ankle injury may end up keeping him out of Scottish Premiership action for a month. (The Courier, external)
Dundee centre-half Owen Bevan is an injury doubt for Wednesday's meeting with Kilmarnock. (The Courier, external)

Sam Johnstone feels better equipped to meet the demands of playing for Celtic since the goalkeeper suffered a bruising debut in their 3-0 Premier Sports Cup quarter-final defeat by Rangers. (The Scotsman, external)
Celtic-supporting former winger David Templeton has revealed then manager Neil Lennon tried to persuade him to snub a move to Rangers in 2012, but Hearts said he would not play for them again if he did not accept the six-figure transfer and instead waited to run out his contract to join their Glasgow rivals. (STV Radio Football Podcast, external)
Dundee United have contacted the Scottish FA to request an explanation after Zac Sapsford had a goal ruled out in contentious fashion during Saturday's 3-2 win over Aberdeen. (The Courier, external)
Former Rangers manager Michael Beale has personally refunded his Zulte Waregem fans their ticket price after they suffered a fourth defeat in a row. (The Herald, external)
Former Motherwell manager Jens Berthel Askou has revealed he had to evacuate his players to a secret location because of riots in Toulouse before their Ligue 1 draw with Troyes. (The Herald, external)

מאמן האל סיטי, סרגיי יאקירוביץ', חשף כי חלוץ נבחרת סקוטלנד אולי מקברני הקיא דם במהלך המחצית במשחק התיקו 1-1 מול ברנטפורד. האירוע מעורר דאגה בקרב אנשי המועדון ובנבחרת לקראת ההמשך.

במקביל, קבוצת הארטס מתכוננת לשבוע מורכב מבחינת סגל השחקנים וממתינה לתוצאות בדיקות של שחקני ההגנה הנרי מילן וכריסטיאן בורכגרבינק, כמו גם להחלמתו של הקשר אוסין מקאנטי. כמו כן, שחקנים נוספים בליגה הסקוטית כמו סם סטנטון מסנט ג'ונסטון ואוון ביוון מדאנדי נמצאים בספק למשחקים הקרובים עקב פציעות שונות.
